details.summary: After the website redesign, the shared footer of the mortgage prequal page no longer shows the NMLS ID (disclosure D-5). The page body still matches approved version 2, but the footer is part of what the member sees. Put the NMLS ID back in the footer.

rule.title: Mortgage ads show the NMLS ID

fields.label: Page title
fields.text: Get prequalified for a ClearPath mortgage

fields.label: Body
fields.text:
Know your budget before you start house hunting.

Prequalify for a ClearPath mortgage in about 10 minutes. We use a soft credit inquiry, so prequalifying does not affect your credit score. You get an estimate of how much you can borrow and which loan types fit you: fixed-rate, adjustable-rate, and loans for first-time buyers.

Prequalification is not a loan approval or a commitment to lend. Your final loan terms depend on a full application, an appraisal and underwriting.

Start your prequalification: clearpathcu.example/mortgage/prequalify

ClearPath Credit Union NMLS #401822. Equal Housing Opportunity. Federally insured by NCUA.

activity.text: Raised this issue and assigned it to Dana Ortiz.

I looked at clearpathcu.example/mortgage/prequalify on my phone: the new footer theme shows only "Equal Housing Opportunity" and the NCUA logo. The NMLS line in the page text is hidden on screens under 768px. SAFE-01 needs it on every screen size.

Thanks. The web team moved the footer to a new theme block. I asked them to add "ClearPath Credit Union NMLS #401822" to the footer on all mortgage pages, not only this one. They expect to ship it on Nov 6.
